name: Azeroth Companion
title: Character Farming Operations — Assignments & Session Ledger
features: Added character-specific Farming Operations inside Loot Hunter, with assignments to multiple manually selected characters
Added an optional import of previously saved public Armory character shortcuts
Added dated manual farming session records with attempt counts and notes per character and item
Added character and goal filters with progress summaries for assigned goals and session activity
Added standalone JSON export/import for character assignments and session history, without touching legacy Loot Hunter backups
Preserved all v2.8 and Talent Forge features, the original farming goals, and existing Cloudflare Worker credentials
